scripts.script:
-- =============================================================================
-- T-800 DYNAMIC VISION EXACT REPLICA (Arceus X NEO)
-- Sürekli akan veriler, pusula ve 3D Vücut Izgarası (Wireframe) içerir.
-- =============================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. ESKİ SİSTEMLERİ TEMİZLE
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("T800_DynamicVision") then 
    CoreGui.T800_DynamicVision:Destroy() 
end
if Lighting:FindFirstChild("T800_Color") then
    Lighting.T800_Color:Destroy()
end

-- 2. KIRMIZI VİZYON FİLTRESİ
local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
cc.Name = "T800_Color"
cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
cc.Brightness = 0.1
cc.Contrast = 0.6
cc.Saturation = -0.5
cc.Parent = Lighting

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "T800_DynamicVision"
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui

-- Kırmızı Ekran Katmanı
local redTint = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)
redTint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
redTint.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
redTint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
redTint.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- 3. HAREKETLİ ARAYÜZ (GUI) ELEMANLARI
local function createText(pos, size, align, sizeText)
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", screenGui)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Position = pos
    l.Size = size
    l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
    l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    l.TextXAlignment = align
    l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    l.TextSize = sizeText or 12
    l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.8
    return l
end

-- Sol Üst Hızlı Akan Kodlar
local leftStream = createText(UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.6, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
-- Sağ Üst Hafıza Adresleri
local rightStream = createText(UDim2.new(0.83, 0, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.6, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
-- Sol Alt Sabit/Değişken Veri
local bottomStream = createText(UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0.8, 0), UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.15, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
-- Ortada Hedef Bilgisi (Sadece kilitlenince çıkar)
local centerAlert = createText(UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.6, 0), UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.1, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, 20)
centerAlert.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

-- Pusula (Orta Sol)
local compassLabel = createText(UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, 14)

-- 4. DİNAMİK YAZI VE PUSULA DÖNGÜSÜ
local function generateHex()
    local chars = "0123456789ABCDEF"
    local result = ""
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local r = math.random(1, 16)
        result = result .. string.sub(chars, r, r)
    end
    return result
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- Sol Taraf Akan Yazılar (Assembly kodu taklidi)
    local lText = ""
    for i = 1, 15 do
        lText = lText .. math.random(100, 199) .. "  " .. generateHex() .. "  " .. generateHex() .. "\n"
    end
    leftStream.Text = lText

    -- Sağ Taraf Akan Yazılar (Adres Taklidi)
    local rText = "KEY PERFECT 4 0\nRUN ON\nOVLY OBJ\n---------------\nCODE    ADDR#\n"
    for i = 1, 10 do
        rText = rText .. generateHex() .. "    " .. generateHex() .. "F\n"
    end
    rightStream.Text = rText

    -- Sol Alt Sistem Verileri
    bottomStream.Text = "29 SLOTA  EQU  $"..string.format("%02X", math.random(0, 255)).."    :ADDRESS ADDER (SLOT# * 16)\n" ..
                        "30 SLOT   EQU  $"..string.format("%02X", math.random(0, 255)).."    :<<< POKE RAMCARD SLOT#\n" ..
                        "31 BANK   EQU  $"..string.format("%02X", math.random(0, 255)).."    :<<< POKE 16K RAM BANK\n" ..
                        "32 COUNT  EQU  $"..string.format("%02X", math.random(0, 255)).."    :HIBYTE # OF POINTS"

    -- Gerçek Zamanlı Pusula (Kamera yönüne göre hesaplanır)
    local look = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local heading = math.atan2(look.X, look.Z)
    local degrees = math.floor(math.deg(heading)) + 180
    compassLabel.Text = "NW    N    NE\n  \\   |   /\n   -- " .. string.format("%03d", degrees) .. " --\n  /   |   \\\nSW    S    SE"
end)

-- 5. CANLI VÜCUT TARAMASI VE IZGARA (WIREFRAME) SİSTEMİ
local currentTarget = nil
local scanBoxes = {}
local targetStatsBill = nil

local function clearScan()
    for _, box in pairs(scanBoxes) do box:Destroy() end
    scanBoxes = {}
    if targetStatsBill then targetStatsBill:Destroy() end
    centerAlert.Text = ""
end

-- Mouse ile bir oyuncuya bakıldığını algılama (RenderStepped ile anlık)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local target = Mouse.Target
    local newTarget = nil

    if target and target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target.Parent)
        if plr and plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            newTarget = target.Parent
        end
    end

    -- Yeni bir hedefe bakılıyorsa taramayı başlat
    if newTarget ~= currentTarget then
        clearScan()
        currentTarget = newTarget

        if currentTarget then
            -- Vücudun her parçasına 3D ızgara (Wireframe) ekle
            for _, part in pairs(currentTarget:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                    box.Adornee = part
                    box.LineThickness = 0.03
                    box.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) -- Beyaz ızgara
                    box.SurfaceTransparency = 0.8
                    box.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
                    box.Parent = CoreGui
                    table.insert(scanBoxes, box)
                end
            end

            -- Hedefin yanına analiz paneli (BillboardGui) ekle
            targetStatsBill = Instance.new("BillboardGui", currentTarget:WaitForChild("Head"))
            targetStatsBill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 150)
            targetStatsBill.ExtentsOffset = Vector3.new(3, 0, 0) -- Sağ tarafta dursun
            targetStatsBill.AlwaysOnTop = true

            local statsText = Instance.new("TextLabel", targetStatsBill)
            statsText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            statsText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            statsText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            statsText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
            statsText.TextSize = 14
            statsText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

            -- Hesaplama taklidi (sayılar sürekli değişir)
            spawn(function()
                local lockTimer = 0
                while currentTarget == newTarget and lockTimer < 30 do -- Yaklaşık 1 saniye tarama
                    statsText.Text = "CRITERIA:\n" ..
                                     "HGHT " .. math.random(100000, 999999) .. " " .. math.random(100, 999) .. "\n" ..
                                     "WGHT " .. math.random(100000, 999999) .. " " .. math.random(100, 999) .. "\n" ..
                                     "NECK " .. math.random(100000, 999999) .. " " .. math.random(100, 999) .. "\n" ..
                                     "SHLD " .. math.random(100000, 999999) .. " " .. math.random(100, 999) .. "\n" ..
                                     "BACK " .. math.random(100000, 999999) .. " " .. math.random(100, 999)
                    
                    centerAlert.Text = "ASSESSING PROBABILITY...\nSCAN MODE 43894"
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    lockTimer = lockTimer + 1
                end
                
                -- Tarama bitince kilitlenir ve sayılar sabitlenir
                if currentTarget == newTarget then
                    centerAlert.Text = "MATCH PROBABILITY .99\nIDENT POSITIVE: " .. string.upper(currentTarget.Name)
                    statsText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0) -- Kırmızıya döner
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Mouse hiçbir şeye bakmıyorsa temizle
    if not newTarget and currentTarget then
        clearScan()
        currentTarget = nil
    end
end)

print("CYBERDYNE SYSTEMS MODEL 101 VISION INITIALIZED.")

SendCorner.Parent = SendBtn

----------------------------------------------------
-- 3. FUNCTIONALITY & LOGIC
----------------------------------------------------

-- Function to handle sending chat messages (Supports old and new Roblox Chat)
local function SendChatMessage(message)
    if message == "" then return end
    
    -- Try TextChatService (New Roblox Chat System)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local textChannel = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels") and TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if textChannel then
            textChannel:SendAsync(message)
        end
    else
        -- Fallback to Legacy Chat System
        local SayMessageRequest = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
        if SayMessageRequest then
            SayMessageRequest:FireServer(message, "All")
        end
    end
end

-- Login Logic
LoginBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if PassInput.Text == CORRECT_PASSWORD then
        LoginFrame:Destroy() -- Delete the password panel completely

        LoginBtn.Text = "Wrong Password!"
        task.wait(1.5)
        LoginBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)
        LoginBtn.Text = "Unlock"
    end
end)

-- Force Text Lock Constraint (Ensures prefix cannot be edited or erased)
MsgTextBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local currentText = MsgTextBox.Text
    -- If the user deletes past the prefix or alters it, reset it back
    if string.sub(currentText, 1, string.len(LOCKED_TEXT)) ~= LOCKED_TEXT then
        MsgTextBox.Text = LOCKED_TEXT
    end
end)

-- Send Button Trigger
SendBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local textToSend = MsgTextBox.Text
    SendChatMessage(textToSend)
end)

-- Minimize Button Logic
local isMinimized = false
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not isMinimized then
        -- Collapse window
        ContainerFrame.Visible = false
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 35)
        MinBtn.Text = "+"
        isMinimized = true
    else
        -- Expand window back
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 160)
        ContainerFrame.Visible = true
        MinBtn.Text = "-"
        isMinimized = false
    end
end)

By claude ai
What Is This?
This script lets you customize any in-game UI by moving, resizing, and deleting buttons or elements wherever you want on your screen

Edit Mode This is what you turn on when you want to start moving stuff around. When it says ON you are in editor mode, when it says OFF nothing can be selected or moved

Save Config Once you are happy with where everything is, hit this to save your layout It saves as v1 then v2 then v3 and so on each time you save

Load Config Opens a list of all your saved layouts so you can pick one to apply. You can also set any save to Auto ON which means it loads automatically every time you run the script without you needing to do anything.

Trash Shows you everything you have deleted. If you deleted something by accident you can get it back from here.


How To Move and Edit Buttons

First turn on Edit Mode. Then tap any button or UI element in the game and it will get highlighted with a cyan outline meaning it is selected. From there you just drag it anywhere you want on screen

 Size+ Makes the selected element bigger each time you tap it

 Size - Makes the selected element smaller each time you tap it

Delete Hides the element completely so it no longer shows on your screen

Note📝This script may not work in some games you can modify it and tell the AI to fix it for you

scripts.script:
local p = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ids = {
    idle1 = "rbxassetid://15500461676",
    idle2 = "rbxassetid://15500462591",
    walk = "rbxassetid://15532927612",
    jump = "rbxassetid://125750702",
    fall = "rbxassetid://180436148",
    sit = "rbxassetid://178130996",
    talk = "rbxassetid://15515461377",
    spray = "rbxassetid://15500463617",
    flash = "rbxassetid://15515552528"
}

local function go(c)
    local h = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local a = c:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if a then
        a:Destroy()
    end
    local an = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if an then
        an:Destroy()
    end
    an = Instance.new("Animator", h)
    local function load(id)
        local a = Instance.new("Animation")
        a.AnimationId = id
        return an:LoadAnimation(a)
    end
    local idle1 = load(ids.idle1)
    local idle2 = load(ids.idle2)
    local walk = load(ids.walk)
    local jump = load(ids.jump)
    local fall = load(ids.fall)
    local sit = load(ids.sit)
    local talk = load(ids.talk)
    local spray = load(ids.spray)
    local flash = load(ids.flash)
    local cur
    local doingAction = false
    local idleFlip = false
    local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
    snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://80416058717151"
    snd.Volume = 2
    snd.Parent = c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local function stopAll()
        if cur then
            cur:Stop()
        end
        snd:Stop()
        doingAction = false
    end
    local function play(track, looped)
        stopAll()
        cur = track
        cur.Looped = looped or false
        cur:Play()
    end
    local function playAction(track, withSound)
        stopAll()
        doingAction = true
        cur = track
        cur.Looped = false
        cur:Play()
        if withSound and cur == track then
            snd:Play()
        end
        cur.Stopped:Connect(
            function()
                if cur == track then
                    doingAction = false
                end
            end
        )
    end
    h.Running:Connect(
        function(speed)
            if doingAction and speed > 1 then
                stopAll()
            end

            if doingAction then
                return
            end

            if speed > 1 then
                play(walk, true)
            else
                idleFlip = not idleFlip
                play(idleFlip and idle1 or idle2, true)
            end
        end
    )
    h.Jumping:Connect(
        function()
            if doingAction then
                stopAll()
                return
            end
            play(jump, false)
        end
    )
    h.FreeFalling:Connect(
        function()
            if doingAction then
                return
            end
            play(fall, true)
        end
    )
    h.Seated:Connect(
        function()
            if doingAction then
                return
            end
            play(sit, true)
        end
    )
    local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui", p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
    local function makeBtn(txt, x)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 45)
        b.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.75, 0)
        b.Text = txt
        b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        b.Parent = g
        local d = false
        local di
        local ds
        local sp
        b.InputBegan:Connect(
            function(i)
                if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    d = true
                    ds = i.Position
                    sp = b.Position
                    i.Changed:Connect(
                        function()
                            if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                                d = false
                            end
                        end
                    )
                end
            end
        )
        b.InputChanged:Connect(
            function(i)
                if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                    di = i
                end
            end
        )
        uis.InputChanged:Connect(
            function(i)
                if i == di and d then
                    local delta = i.Position - ds
                    b.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + delta.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                end
            end
        )
        return b
    end
    local bTalk = makeBtn("Talk", 20)
    local bSpray = makeBtn("Spray", 180)
    local bFlash = makeBtn("Flash", 340)
    bTalk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(
        function()
            playAction(talk, true)
        end
    )
    bSpray.MouseButton1Click:Connect(
        function()
            playAction(spray, false)
        end
    )
    bFlash.MouseButton1Click:Connect(
        function()
            playAction(flash, false)
        end
    )
end
if p.Character then
    go(p.Character)
end
p.CharacterAdded:Connect(go)
